about_the_game:
"My grandpa turned into a zombie. At least he stopped asking when I’m having kids" is a project consisting of two main parts:

  • A retro-style action shooter inspired by Zombies Ate My Neighbors.

  • A level editor that allows players to build their own levels and campaigns, and share them with others.

All levels included with the game are built using the internal editor, which means players have the same tools for creating content as the developers.

Main features of the action shooter:

  • Local co-op.

  • Fully destructible environment.

  • Various weapons and upgrades.

  • Choose between melee, ranged, or hybrid characters.

  • 2.5D graphics that keep the feel of retro games while adding the flexibility of a third dimension.

Main features of the level editor:

  • Same tools as the developers.

  • Cloud upload, rating system, and leaderboards.

  • Ability to create multi-level campaigns.

  • Multi-layered design: underground tunnels, basements, second floors, rooftops.

  • Flexible customization of weapon stats, enemy types, hero parameters, and enemy strength and count.
